integrity: Finite exact verification of Johnson transitions, stationary entrance flux and entrance bounds; asymptotic limit is supplied by a separate analytic spectral proof. Finite tests are not infinite certification.
scientific_limitations: Fixed positive integers \(1\le s<r\); uniform one-at-a-time replacement, finite Johnson graphs and full s-subset shadow coverage. This does not address growing r or s, nonuniform replacements or quantitative finite-n convergence rates. Broader historical-priority claims require independent confirmation.
title: A Gumbel law for Markovian super-coupon collection
